firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a horse starts as Dealer and places the first Posse Token. Random selection is also an official option.
houseFallback: If the criterion leaves a tie, nobody qualifies, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested fallback.
clarifications: The Dealer first shuffles and deals the Poker Cards. Posse placement then begins with that same player and continues clockwise.
Pass the Dealer Token clockwise at the end of each round.
In solo mode, you place a Posse Token before the Rival responds; the human player's turn always comes first.

internalEvidence: Read all 9 cached rule sections in full, including setup, turn sequence and relevant variants. Dized identifies Gamelyn Games as publisher and labels these rules publisher-maintained. Setup step 6 assigns the Dealer by latest horse sighting or random selection. The gameplay summary and Posse Placement both confirm the Dealer actually takes the first placement turn. Solo Posse Placement explicitly reverses any need to choose between human and automated Rival: human always acts first. Credits identify TEW05 and copyright 2016–2022.
